subject: Request: Short pilot term adjustment & pricing clarification for Acadia Health POC
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acadia pilot: quick ask on term and pricing for the eval

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the session yesterday. The technical team was happy with latency numbers and the health-data redaction demo seemed to land well. Per our conversation you asked whether we could: (1) extend the POC by two weeks to let the clinical ops team finish the integration tests, and (2) see if there’s a modest trial discount to account for the extra run-time.

Quick context: current POC runs 30 days, covers up to 6k inference minutes and three clinician seats. If we do a 14-day extension we’ll need to increase the inference minutes cap to 9k.

Could you confirm: preferred end date for the extension, whether Acadia needs an updated SOW, and any internal approval process we should expect?

I’ve looped in Monica on pricing — she can advise on one-time extension discounts and the SOW. If it helps, we can ship a one-page addendum to the existing SOW and a DocuSign link for signatures.

Thanks —
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: Acadia_POC_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acadia pilot: quick ask on term and pricing for the eval

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the follow-up.

We can do the extension, but two items to flag from our side: (a) procurement wants any extension >7 days to be reviewed for budget impact, and (b) security requires a completed evidence bundle for the extra period (logs + retention notes). Priya is our procurement lead; she’ll own the budget review.

Our ask on pricing: would Redwood consider a 25% one-time credit on the extra 14 days (applied to overage minutes)? If full credit isn’t possible, we’d consider a capped credit up to $6k.

If you can send an addendum with the new end date, updated caps, and the credit language, we’ll review it internally. End date target from us would be 2025-07-14 (two weeks past the original 2025-06-30).

—Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director, Clinical Integrations | Acadia Health
j.ellis@acadiahealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acadia pilot: quick ask on term and pricing for the eval

Marissa / Monica — forwarding Jordan’s ask. They want a two-week extension to 2025-07-14 and are proposing a 25% one-time credit on the incremental usage (or a capped $6k credit). Procurement will escalate if we can’t provide something reasonable.

Key constraints: original POC scope: 30 days / 6k minutes / 3 seats. Proposed extension implies +3k minutes. They also need the security evidence bundle for the extension window.

Can we do: (A) a one-time credit of 25% on additional minutes OR (B) capped credit of $6k — whichever is smaller, with the standard SOW addendum and a signed DocuSign (I’ll prepare). Also confirm whether support needs to flag any extra data retention or logging config for the extended window.

Appreciate fast turnaround — Jordan indicated procurement reviews next Tues 24th.

Thanks —
Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acadia pilot: quick ask on term and pricing for the eval

Rafael —

We can approve a one-time promotional credit for this POC extension with these guardrails: 
- Credit equals 25% off the incremental usage for the extension period, capped at $5,500 total (note: slightly below their $6k ask).
- Extension window limited to 14 calendar days ending 2025-07-14.
- Addendum must be signed (DocuSign link), and Acadia must confirm the success criteria (two integration test cases passing and one production-simulated batch run).
- Security will provide the evidence bundle; Monica, can you confirm whether any additional logging config is required or if the existing retention policy covers the extra window?

Legal prefers the credit be applied as an account-level invoice credit (one-off) rather than retroactive rate change. Procurement teams are used to that flow.

Rafael, go ahead and prepare the addendum with the credit language and the SOW attachment. Tag the DocuSign to route to Priya for procurement sign-off.

—Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acadiahealth.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acadia POC addendum & next steps (DocuSign sent)

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the patience. Per Marissa’s approval we’re proposing the following:

- Extension: 14-day extension to end on 2025-07-14
- Usage cap: additional 3,000 inference minutes for the extension period
- Credit: 25% credit on incremental minutes for the extension, capped at $5,500 (applied as a single invoice credit after extension closes)
- Success criteria: two integration test cases passing + one production-simulated batch run (details in addendum)
- Security evidence: attached security_responses_acadia.xlsx; Monica confirmed no special logging changes required beyond existing retention config.

Attached: Acadia_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (with addendum language). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/s/abcd-efgh-1234 — routed to Priya for procurement + Jordan for signature. Please review and sign by 2025-07-02 to avoid procurement delay.

If you prefer a call to walk the SOW addendum, I’m available tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Best —
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acadia_POC_SOW_v1.pdf, security_responses_acadia.xlsx
